name: Le Coq Sportif
verdict: French sportswear brand owned since July 2025 by a consortium led by Dan Mamane. Nothing found.
note: Kit maker ('Sponsor Indumentaria') of the UAR national teams, including Los Pumas, per lospumas.com.ar's sponsors page and the UAR's 25 May 2026 shirt launch. Rated none: the ownership claim names a private consortium (Dan Mamane, with backing reported from Mirabaud Patrimoine Vivant and Itochu) - no state or state fund in the chain, and no human-rights finding against the company was found.
